title: Operations Manager For Agency - Online Business Manager
description:
We are a content agency looking to hire a operations manager for our agency. We produce UGC video ads for brands and manage everything from scripting to filming to editing. We are a small, fast-growing remote team and we are looking for an operations manager who genuinely wants to run the machine.



Is this you?

- You wake up thinking about how to make systems better.

- You spot problems before your boss does and come with solutions not just observations.

- You take full ownership of outcomes without being chased.

- You execute first and refine later. You do not debate instructions.

- When something goes wrong you say here is what happened and here is what I am doing about it.



I am looking for someone to be my second in command as the founder. 



Is this also you? Then this is not the right role.

- You need a lot of direction before you can move.

- You push back more than you execute.

 - You look for ways to reduce your own responsibilities when the work feels heavy.

- You get defensive when you receive feedback.

- You prefer to think strategically rather than get into the details.





What the Role Actually Looks Like

You are the hub of everything. The founder hands off a client after onboarding and you make sure every deliverable, every deadline, and every tea
mber is coordinated from that point forward. The founder should be able to step away for two weeks, come back, and find everything running exactly as she left it. That is the standard.



You will manage a small remote team including a copywriter, video editor, talent manager, QA specialist, and client success manager. Your job is to make sure they all have what they need, know what they are doing, and deliver on time. You are the person who makes sure nothing falls through.



What You Will Be Doing

- Brief every department after client onboarding — the team needs full context from you before they start

- Track every deliverable across every active client and make sure nothing slips

- Onboard and train new tea
mbers properly — full context, loom walkthroughs, time to learn before they touch a live client

- Build and continuously improve systems and SOPs so the business gets more organised as it grows

- QA scripts and videos before they reach clients — zero errors leave your desk

- Send a daily EOD report and morning action plan without being asked — every single day

- Flag problems to the founder before she notices them, not after

- Be the single point of accountability between the founder and the team

- Prepare director briefs for every shoot — complete, clear, and sent in advance with pronunciations and key guidance

- Coordinate shoot logistics including timetables, talent briefs, and studio bookings



What We Are Looking For

- Executes first, refines later — not someone who debates every instruction before moving

- Proactive by default — you do not wait to be chased and you do not need reminders

- Genuinely detail-oriented — you check your own work before it goes anywhere

- Takes feedback without getting defensive — accountability is not optional here

- Strong communicator who keeps everyone informed before being asked

- Experience in operations, project management, or agency coordination

- Comfortable with Notion, Slack, Google Drive, 
, and similar tools

- Available Monday to Saturday and responsive during EST business hours

- Someone who takes pride in building systems that outlast them



What This Role Is Not

This is not a strategic advisory role where you think big thoughts and let others execute. This is floor two work. You are in the middle of everything making the machine run. The strategic layer comes later as the business grows and earns it.



This role is not for you if

- You want to delegate your core responsibilities to others

- You are looking for a role where you can reduce your workload over time by offloading to junior staff

- You need extensive management support to stay on track

- You struggle to follow instructions when you disagree with them

- Daily accountability reporting feels like micromanagement to you





The Details

- Full-time, remote

- Monday to Saturday availability required — clients do not stop on weekends

- Must be available and responsive during EST business hours

- Competitive rate depending on experience

- Start date: as soon as possible



How to Apply

Send us a short messagetelling us about a specific time you built or improved a system in a previous role. What was broken, what you did, and what changed as a result.

title: Influencer Marketing Manager
description:
Hi, I’m Loic, the founder of a fast-growing, 7-figure US-based direct-to-consumer skincare brand on track to hit 8 figures this year. We create targeted body care specifically designed for mature women.



We are entering a critical growth phase. I am looking for a relentless, highly organized, and financially driven Influencer Marketing Manager to build our creator pipeline from the ground up.



You need to deeply understand our brand identity and have the sharp eye required to source creators who naturally align with it. We do not work with over-processed, hyper-filtered "influencers." We want authentic, realistic creators who actually influence their audience.



The Reality of the Role:

This is a sales and operations role, not a creative design role. You are a "Hunter."

Your core job is pitching, negotiating, and closing deals with creators. You will manage spreadsheets, negotiate usage rights for our Meta and Google ads, and track the exact Return on Ad Spend (ROAS) your network generates. If you are afraid of sending cold outreach DMs or negotiating hard on a contract, this is not the role for you.



CRITICAL REQUIREMENT: You must have direct experience sourcing creators and negotiating content usage rights (UGC) specifically for paid advertising funnels in the e-commerce/DTC space.



What You Will Do:



Sourcing & Vetting: Hunt down high-converting creators across Instagram and TikTok whose audience and aesthetic perfectly align with our brand and demographic.



End-to-End Outreach: Pitch the brand, negotiate rates, secure whitelist/usage rights, and manage contract compliance.



Logistics & Seeding: Own the product seeding pipeline. Ensure our unboxing experience is delivered on time, and relentlessly follow up to ensure creators post on schedule.



ROI Tracking: Set up affiliate promo codes, track the CPA (Cost Per Acquisition), and brutally evaluate which creators actually drive profitable sales vs. those who just generate vanity metrics.



Community Building: Transition one-off creators into long-term brand evangelists.



Who You Are:



DTC Operator: You understand the mechanics of Direct Response marketing. You know the difference between organic reach and paid media usage rights.



Relentless Follow-up: You don't take "no response" personally. You are highly organized and can manage 50+ simultaneous creator relationships without letting a single deliverable slip.



Aesthetic Filter: You know immediately when a creator looks off-brand or inauthentic.



Financially Driven: You understand that your success is measured by profitable revenue, not just the number of videos collected.



Tech-Comfortable: You live in spreadsheets, Shopify, Google Drive, and creator-management platforms.



What We Provide:



Direct Access: You report directly to me (the Founder). No middle management.



Aggressive Upside: A competitive base salary plus an uncapped performance commission tied directly to the trackable revenue your creator network generates. As the company scales to 8 figures, your income scales with it.



???? HOW TO APPLY (Read Carefully) ????



We ignore all generic, AI-generated applications. To prove you read this, have the required attention to detail, and actually know how to negotiate, you must follow these exact steps:



1. The Subject Line:

Make the subject line of your application: "Creator Hunter: [Insert Your Favorite Color]"



2. The Video Intro (Required):

Record a 1 to 2-minute Loom video introducing yourself. Tell me why you want to work for a skincare brand targeting mature women, and briefly describe the most difficult negotiation you successfully navigated with a creator. Applications without a video link will be instantly deleted.



3. The Sourcing Test:

Find one specific creator on Instagram or TikTok who you believe perfectly aligns with our brand (mature demographic, authentic/natural aesthetic). Paste the link to their profile, and in two sentences, explain exactly why they will convert for us.



4. The Pitch Test:

Imagine you found a creator with 50,000 highly engaged followers in our demographic. Write the exact cold-outreach DM you would send her to pitch a collaboration where we send her free product in exchange for a video we can run as a Meta Ad. (Hint: Keep it concise, respectful, and focused on mutual value).



Please attach your resume and send your application following the steps above. I look forward to meeting you!

Grid Ownership: Schedule and publish all organic content across Instagram and TikTok. You own the visual flow and pacing of our feeds.

Copywriting: Write intelligent, engaging captions that educate our audience and drive community interaction. No generic, robotic marketing speak.



Community Cultivation: Act as the voice of the brand in the comments and DMs, engaging with our audience in a professional, warm, and direct tone.



Who You Are:



Aesthetic Filter: You know immediately what makes a post look native to a brand versus what looks like cheap filler.

Empathetic Writer: You know how to write copy that resonates with a mature woman—treating her with respect, not talking down to her.



Highly Reliable: You manage your own time efficiently. You don't need to be micromanaged to ensure posts go live and comments are answered.



What We Provide:



Direct Access: You report directly to me (the Founder). No middle management.



Flexibility: This is a fractional, remote role designed to fit around your schedule, provided the grid stays flawless and the community is engaged.



???? HOW TO APPLY (Read Carefully) ????



We ignore all generic, AI-generated applications. To prove you read this, have the required attention to detail, and actually have an eye for brand curation, you must follow these exact steps:



1. The Subject Line:

Make the subject line of your application: "Brand Curator: [Insert Your Favorite Animal]"

Record a 1 to 2-minute Loom video introducing yourself. Tell me why you want to work for a skincare brand targeting mature women, and briefly describe your philosophy on what makes a DTC brand's Instagram grid successful. Applications without a video link will be instantly deleted.

Find one specific e-commerce brand on Instagram (in the wellness, beauty, or lifestyle space) that you believe has an exceptional, highly cohesive organic grid. Paste the link to their profile, and in two sentences, explain exactly why their curation works.

Write the exact Instagram caption you would use for this post. (Hint: Keep our mature demographic in mind. Be engaging, authentic, and include a clear call-to-action).



Please attach your portfolio (or links to accounts you have managed) and send your application following the steps above. I look forward to meeting you!

title: Copywriter / Ghostwriter - Full time
description:
Copywriter / Ghostwriter - Full time



We are not looking for someone to schedule posts and reply with emojis.



We need a ghostwriter who understands psychology first, social media second.



Someone who can sit inside a CEO's head, write what he'd actually say, and make a stranger stop scrolling and think "wait, who is this."



What you'll actually do:



1. Write content for the CEO and the company page.

Research the news in our space. Understand exactly who we're talking to (ICP). Write posts that trigger curiosity, not posts that look nice and get ignored.



2. Get in the comments.

Talk to brand owners and ecom people in their world, not just ours. Real replies. Real opinions. Not "Great point!"



3. Find prospects and start conversations.

DM them. Follow up. Book meetings. This is sales-adjacent work, not just content work.



What matters more than anything else:



You understand why people stop scrolling. Why someone replies to a stranger's comment. Why a DM gets answered instead of ignored. That's psychology, not a content calendar.



You write like a person, not a content machine.

Real sentences. Real opinions. The occasional typo or rough edge is fine.

We'd rather have an honest, slightly imperfect post than a polished one that sounds like every other LinkedIn post out there.



What we don't need you to already know:



The technical side of social media - platforms, formatting, posting schedules, repurposing one LinkedIn post into X, Instagram, and
 versions. That's teachable. Writing voice and psychology are not.



Big plus:



You know how to use Claude or GPT to scale this process without it sounding like AI wrote it. If you can use AI as a tool and still produce something that sounds like a real person typed it in five minutes, that's exactly the skill set we want



Background we're looking for:



Copywriting or ghostwriting experience. Someone who has written for a founder, a personal brand, or a CEO before - and can show us posts that actually got engagement, not just posts that exist.



Task - send this back to us in your own words, no AI:



Pick any LinkedIn post from a founder or CEO in the ecommerce / Amazon / agency space that you think is genuinely good. Send us the link.



Then tell us in 3-4 sentences:

- Why did this post stop you from scrolling

- What's the psychological trigger it's using (curiosity, status, fear of missing out, controversy, etc.)

- What would you have changed if you wrote it



We want your real opinion, written the way you'd text a friend about it. Not a polished essay.

title: QA Analyst : ERP & Business Systems URGENT
description:
We're looking for someone who knows accounting and will be a key voice in the direction of the software we create.



At Hutility, we build and support ERP customizations, integrations, automation, and custom software for organizations running on Sage 300 and similar platforms. We're looking for someone who's experienced in the accounting workflows we're building for: someone who can look at what the software does and know whether it makes sense for a real business.



What you'll be doing

·	Review and validate ERP features, fixes, and enhancements by asking whether they make sense from an accounting perspective

·	Follow transactions end-to-end across workflows like AP, AR, GL, procurement, billing, payroll, and inventory, and flag when something doesn't behave the way a real business would expect

·	Work directly with developers and consultants to explain what the expected business outcome should be

·	Document issues clearly: what happened, what should have happened, and why it matters

·	Help the team understand the real-world impact of a bug or design decision on accounting accuracy, reporting, and day-to-day operations

·	Apply structured QA practices over time: test planning, regression testing, defect tracking, etc.



You'll be a great fit if you...

·	Have hands-on experience in an accounting role: AP, AR, GL, payroll, inventory, procurement, or similar

·	Have used an ERP or accounting system in a real work environment (Sage, SAP, QuickBooks, NetSuite, Dynamics, Acumatica, or even Excel-heavy environments)

·	Can walk a developer through what "correct" looks like for a transaction, a report, or a reconciliation

·	Notice when numbers, postings, or workflows don't add up. Even when no error message fires

·	Are curious about how software works and genuinely interested in learning the technical side

·	Pick things up quickly and enjoy figuring things out on your own

·	Communicate clearly: you can make complicated situations easy to understand



What success looks like

·	Developers get clear, actionable feedback grounded in how accounting actually works

·	Issues are caught before they cause incorrect postings, broken reconciliations, or problems that impact the business downstream

·	The team builds more confidence that what they're shipping reflects real-world accounting logic, not just technical correctness

·	You grow into owning the QA process over time, with the accounting knowledge as your foundation

·	This role can branch into many career possibilities such as ERP consulting, software development, management, etc., depending on your skills and interests.

description:
Job Overview:

We are seeking a dynamic and highly motivated KOL Manager to oversee and grow our TikTok influencer marketing efforts in Philippines. The ideal candidate will be responsible for identifying, engaging, and managing relationships with TikTok influencers to drive brand awareness, engagement, and ultimately sales in the local market.

Key Responsibilities:

1. KOL Strategy Development:

  - Develop and implement a comprehensive TikTok KOL influencer strategy aligned with brand objectives, market trends, and consumer insights in Vietnam.

  - Create campaigns that drive engagement, brand awareness, and conversion, with clear KPIs and measurable outcomes.

2. KOL Research and Identification:

  - Identify and establish relationships with top-tier and micro-influencers in Vietnam who align with the brand’s values, target audience, and goals.

  - Stay up-to-date with TikTok trends and emerging influencers to ensure the brand is always at the forefront of the platform.

  - Oversee end-to-end influencer campaign execution, from briefing and content creation to final delivery and performance analysis.

  - Ensure influencers’ content aligns with brand guidelines, voice, and overall marketing strategy.

  - Negotiate contracts, terms, and compensation with influencers and influencer agencies to ensure mutually beneficial partnerships.

  - Collaborate with internal teams (creative, PR, and marketing) to ensure influencer content is integrated seamlessly into the overall marketing strategy.

5. Performance Tracking and Reporting:

  - Monitor the performance of KOL campaigns on TikTok, track key metrics (engagement, reach, conversions), and optimize strategies accordingly.

  - Provide regular reports and insights to management on campaign effectiveness, ROI, and influencer impact.

6. Community Building:

  - Build and nurture long-term relationships with influencers to foster loyalty and repeat collaborations.

  - Engage in community management by interacting with influencers’ audiences and ensuring positive brand sentiment.

7. Market and Competitor Insights:

  - Monitor competitors' influencer strategies on TikTok and analyze trends in influencer marketing within Philippine’s digital landscape.

  - Use data and insights to continuously improve and adapt the influencer strategy.

Qualifications:

- Proven experience in influencer marketing or KOL management, ideally in the TikTok ecosystem, preferably within Philippines.

- Excellent negotiation and communication skills.

- Creative mindset with an ability to think outside the box to create viral content.

Preferred:

You'll be responsible for transforming RAW property photographs into premium marketing images that showcase homes at their absolute best while maintaining a natural, realistic appearance.

* Replace skies naturally when required.

* The ability to work independently and meet deadlines consistently.

* Produce consistent, premium-quality work.

**
**

Editing direct-response video ads in German for Meta (VSLs, advertorials, UGC mashups, talking-heads, problem-agitate-solve formats)

What Makes You Perfect for This Role:



You have a proven track record editing high-converting video content for DTC brands, particularly in health supplements or similar direct response niches. You understand that every frame, transition, and text overlay serves a strategic purpose—building trust, creating urgency, and driving action.



You know the difference between content that looks pretty and content that sells. You've studied winning ad creatives, you understand hooks that stop the scroll, and you can craft testimonial sequences that feel authentic while hitting every psychological trigger.



You're experienced with the full spectrum of DTC video content:
/Instagram ads, YouTube pre-rolls, VSLs, advertorials, UGC-style content, and product demos. You understand pacing, music selection, subtitle styling, and the specific editing techniques that work for different platforms and audiences.



Your Experience Includes:



3+ years editing for DTC ecommerce brands (health/wellness/supplements is a major plus)

Deep portfolio of video ads that have generated significant revenue

Expertise in creating video content for audiences 50+ (understanding their viewing preferences and pain points)

Mastery of direct response video techniques: pattern interrupts, benefit stacking, social proof integration, scarcity/urgency elements

Understanding of the customer journey and how video fits into different funnel stages

Experience collaborating with copywriters and marketers to bring scripts to life



Technical Requirements:



Strong skills in After Effects for motion graphics and text animations

Ability to color grade, audio mix, and deliver broadcast-quality final products

Fast turnaround times without sacrificing quality

Experience with both short-form (15-60 second ads) and long-form (3-15 minute VSLs) content



What We're Looking For:



Someone who asks "Will this increase conversions?" not just "Does this look good?"

A student of direct response marketing who constantly analyzes what's working in the market

Excellent communication skills and ability to implement feedback quickly

Reliability and consistency—we need someone who delivers on time, every time

Proactive mindset: you spot opportunities to improve content and suggest creative solutions



Compensation & Details:

title: # Cinematic Real Estate Video Editor
description:
# Cinematic Real Estate Video Editor



## Position Overview



We are looking for a talented Cinematic Real Estate Video Editor to help build one of Australia's leading premium real estate media brands.



This is not a role for someone who simply cuts clips together. We are looking for an editor who understands storytelling, pacing, emotion, and marketing. Every video should feel intentional, cinematic, and elevate the property's value.



Our goal is to create timeless, premium real estate films that stand apart from the fast-paced, over-edited style commonly seen in the industry. We value clean editing, thoughtful sequencing, natural motion, and visual quality over flashy effects.



If your editing style relies heavily on speed ramps, excessive transitions, or trending effects, this role is probably not the right fit.



---



## Key Responsibilities



### Cinematic Video Editing



* Edit premium real estate property films using Adobe Premiere Pro.

* Create polished, cinematic videos that showcase each property's lifestyle and character.

* Build strong narratives that guide viewers naturally through the home.

* Maintain smooth pacing and clean visual flow throughout every project.

* Deliver content suitable for luxury residential marketing.



### Storytelling



* Select the strongest clips to create an engaging narrative.

* Understand how buyers experience a home and edit to match that journey.

* Use timing, composition, movement, and music to create emotion.

* Highlight the property's best features without making the edit feel rushed.



### Brand Consistency



* Learn and maintain our premium editing style.

* Ensure every project aligns with our visual identity and brand standards.

* Maintain consistency across all client videos.

* Create edits that strengthen our reputation as a premiu
dia company.



### Audio & Music



* Select music that complements each property.

* Edit naturally to the rhythm without over-cutting.

* Balance music and ambient audio where appropriate.

* Create immersive viewing experiences.



### Colour & Finishing



* Apply or refine colour grading to maintain a clean, natural, high-end aesthetic.

* Ensure exposure, white balance, and colour remain consistent throughout the edit.

* Perform final quality checks before delivery.



### Marketing Awareness



* Understand that every video is a marketing tool.

* Edit with the goal of increasing engagement and helping properties stand out.

* Produce videos suitable for social media, listing websites, and premium brand marketing.



---



## Required Skills



* Advanced experience with Adobe Premiere Pro.

* Strong understanding of cinematic editing principles.

* Excellent storytelling ability.

* Experience editing professional real estate videos.

* Strong understanding of pacing and rhythm.

* Ability to organise projects efficiently.

* High attention to detail.

* Ability to work quickly without compromising quality.

* Strong communication skills.

* Ability to accept feedback and continuously improve.



---



## Preferred Experience



Experience editing:



* Luxury residential properties.

* Architectural films.

* Interior design content.

* Lifestyle and brand videos.

* Commercial real estate.

* Drone footage.

* Gimbal footage.



Experience with:



* Adobe After Effects (basic titles and motion graphics only).

* Adobe Lightroom and Photoshop (an advantage, but not essential).



---



## What We're Looking For



We want someone who understands that great editing is often subtle.



Our ideal editor:



* Thinks like a filmmaker, not just an editor.

* Understands how to build emotion through sequencing.

* Creates edits that feel intentional and refined.

* Values clean, timeless editing over flashy effects.

* Takes pride in producing work that clients are excited to share.



We are building a premium brand, and every video should reflect that standard.



---



## Success in This Role



A successful editor will consistently produce cinematic real estate films that elevate our brand and our clients' properties. They will work efficiently, communicate well, meet deadlines, and deliver videos that combine technical excellence with compelling storytelling.

title: Amazon Operations and Team Manager SOPs | KPIs | 3+ Years
description:
Who We Are

BTS Brands is an 8-year-old private label company selling across US, CA, UK, EU, AU, JP and expanding into Saudi Arabia. We operate across two brands: one in travel accessories and one in beauty devices, with 52+ active SKUs. We're at a turning point: moving from a founder-run business to a properly managed, systems-run company. This role is central to that transition.



The Role

This is not a VA role. This is an operations and team management position for someone who has done this before in an ecommerce or Amazon environment.

You will report directly to the two Founders and manage a team of 8-9 people across our Creative and Operations teams. You'll take our existing processes - currently scattered and undocumented --and build a proper system in ClickUp from scratch. You'll create SOPs, track KPIs, run tea
etings, and make sure everyone knows what they're doing and when.

Your mission is to build the systems, rhythm, and accountability that let the company run smoothly, without the founders being involved in every daily decision.

If you need someone to tell you what to do every day, this isn't the right fit. If you thrive with clear objectives and the autonomy to build real systems, keep reading.



What You'll Do:

- Set up ClickUp from scratch across all departments: workflows, dashboards, automations, task structures

- Make sure all work is captured in the system - nothing managed informally or lost in chat

- Coordinate between Creative and Operations teams so projects move smoothly

- Document existing business processes into clear, usable SOPs

- Handle day-to-day approvals within defined boundaries, escalating only real issues to the founders

- Lead weekly/monthly KPI reviews and quarterly planning sessions

- Run the weekly tea
eting - status updates, blockers, decisions - focused and on time

- Translate founders' quarterly objectives into clear team and individual goals

- Monitor performance, spot problems early, and drive corrective action

- Build and manage the product-launch workflow based on the existing 15-step launch process

- Spot what's slowing the team down and fix it - don't just flag it

- Keep an eye on profitability alongside the founders

- Onboard new hires: set up tools, assign SOPs, guide their first weeks



Tools You Must Know:

- ClickUp - expert level, you've built systems from scratch before

- Google Sheets / Excel - KPI dashboards, reporting

- Slack or similar - team communication

- Amazon Seller Central - you don't need to be a specialist, but you need to understand the context

- Zoom - weekly meetings with owner and team



Who We're Looking For:

We're looking for someone who's been in the trenches of ecommerce operations - not someone who's managed tasks, but someone who's built systems and led people.



- 3+ years in operations or team management in an ecommerce or Amazon environment

- You've built SOPs from scratch and know how to make processes that people actually follow

- You've set up ClickUp or similar tools for a team starting from zero

- You know how to keep a remote team aligned and accountable - without being on their back every hour

- You're comfortable with numbers - KPIs, margins, performance tracking

- Excellent English, written and verbal

- Familiarity with Amazon tools

- You're looking for somewhere to grow long-term, not just another contract



Compensation & Setup:

- $1,200–$1,600+/month based on experience

- Full-time, 40h/week

- 14 days paid leave after 3 months

- First 3 months: time-tracked via Time Doctor as part of our standard onboarding process

- Long-term position - We Invest in People Who Invest in Us



What Success Looks Like

- Within 1 month: ClickUp is fully adopted, the weekly rhythm is running, and the founders' approval load has dropped significantly

- Within 3 months: KPIs are tracked and reviewed consistently; the team works to clear quarterly goals

- Within 6 months: the company runs smoothly day-to-day without the founders being involved in every decision



To Apply - Required

Answer these 4 questions. Applications without answers will not be considered:



1. Describe a project management system you built from scratch (ClickUp, Asana, Monday, or similar) — what was the situation, how did you structure it, and what changed after? Only apply if you have actually done this. Do not describe what you would do - describe what you did.

2. How do you hold a remote team accountable without micromanaging? Give a real example from one of the companies listed in your CV: include the team size, what tool you used, and what happened when someone missed a deadline. Do not describe what you would do — describe what you actually did.

3. You join BTS Brands on Monday. By Friday you need to send the founders your first weekly summary. What's in it and how did you get that information in 5 days?

4. What project management tools have you used, and rate your confidence in each from 1 to 10. For the tool you rated highest - what's one thing you can do in it that most people don't know about?

title: Social Media Manager / Account Owner
description:
Who We Are:

If you're someone who is:

Position Details:

* ?? Be part of something exciting. This group travel company combines wellness, parties, adventure, networking, and unforgettable experiences into trips that people genuinely look forward to.

* ???? Bring your creativity to life. We value talent who contribute ideas, spot trends, and puts passion into their creative work.

* ???? Growth potential. This role starts with one exciting client, but if it's a great fit, you'll have the opportunity to take on additional client accounts within Cora Marie Media as our agency continues to grow.

* Flexibility with Accountability — Work remotely and manage your own schedule. We care about excellence and meeting deadlines—not micromanagement.

* Growth Opportunities — We love rewarding great people. Perform well in this role and you'll have opportunities to work on additional client accounts as Cora Marie Media continues to grow.



Employment Type:

Application Process:

Please include the word "Passport" after your first and last name when you apply. Share your portfolio and tell us why you'd be excited to create content for a fun, fast-growing travel brand.

description:
# Full-Time Project Manager for Web Design and SEO Agency



## About Frisco Web Agency



Frisco Web Agency is a growing web design and digital marketing agency based in Frisco, Texas. Our primary service is designing and developing custom websites for service-based businesses. We also manage ongoing Search Engine Optimization campaigns and occasionally take on other digital projects.



We are currently a small team of three:



* Christopher Potter — Owner

* Rocky Diana — Web Developer

* Melissa Saldana — Administrative Support



We are looking for a full-time Project Manager who can take ownership of our client projects, organize our fulfillment process, and keep everything moving forward without requiring constant direction.



## The Main Outcome of This Role



The most important responsibility of this position is simple:



**Make sure every project continues moving forward and is completed on time—or preferably ahead of schedule.**



As the owner, Christopher needs to focus more of his time on marketing, sales, strategy, and growing the company. Right now, managing multiple active projects can pull him away from those responsibilities.



Your role will be to take ownership of the day-to-day management of our fulfillment.



You will need to know:



* Where every project currently stands

* What has already been completed

* What still needs to be completed

* Who is responsible for each task

* What is due next

* What is falling behind

* What information we are waiting on

* What the client needs to know

* What could prevent us from meeting a deadline



We do not want someone who only updates tasks after being told what to do. We need someone who thinks ahead, identifies problems early, communicates clearly, and actively pushes projects toward completion every day.



## Primary Responsibilities



### Manage Website Projects



Most of your work will involve managing custom website design and development projects.



You will be responsible for:



* Setting up and organizing projects in ClickUp

* Reviewing each active project every day

* Creating and assigning tasks

* Confirming that tasks have clear descriptions, deadlines, and owners

* Following up with team members about incomplete or overdue work

* Identifying the next steps before the current steps are completed

* Coordinating design, content, development, revisions, quality assurance, and launch

* Gathering missing information and materials from clients

* Communicating project updates to clients

* Preventing projects from becoming stalled

* Keeping projects on schedule and pushing for early completion

* Escalating problems before they become emergencies



### Manage SEO Campaigns



Website projects will be the primary responsibility, but you will also help manage ongoing SEO campaigns.



This may include:



* Organizing monthly SEO deliverables in ClickUp

* Confirming that assigned SEO work is completed

* Coordinating content, website updates, keyword research, on-page optimization, and reporting

* Tracking recurring monthly responsibilities

* Preparing client updates

* Following up on missing approvals or information

* Making sure monthly deliverables do not get overlooked



You do not need to be an advanced SEO strategist, but you should be willing to learn our process and understand enough to manage the work effectively.



### Communicate With Clients



You will become one of the main points of contact for active client projects.



Communication may take place through:



*

* ClickUp

* Google Meet

* Internal team messages



You will be responsible for:

* Following up when a client has not responded

* Setting realistic expectations

* Keeping communication professional, organized, and easy to understand

* Making sure clients do not have to ask us repeatedly for updates

### Communicate With the Team



You will communicate with our team throughout the workday, Monday through Friday.



This includes:



* Reviewing progress with team members

* Following up on tasks

* Answering project-related questions

* Clarifying priorities

* Identifying blockers

* Confirming deadlines

* Making sure team members understand what is expected

* Communicating important client feedback

### Own and Improve ClickUp



ClickUp is the primary project management system used by Frisco Web Agency.



You will be expected to:



* Keep ClickUp accurate and up to date

* Make sure tasks are assigned correctly

* Maintain deadlines, statuses, dependencies, and priorities

* Ensure task descriptions contain enough information for the work to be completed

* Keep client and internal communication organized

* Improve dashboards, templates, automations, and workflows

* Identify areas where ClickUp is becoming confusing or inefficient

* Make ClickUp a reliable source of truth for the entire company



At any time, we should be able to open ClickUp and quickly understand the status of every project.



### Maintain Company Playbooks



We use the Buy Back Your Time playbook method to document how work should be completed.



You will help:



* Create playbooks for repeatable processes

* Update playbooks when our processes change

* Organize instructions, videos, links, and resources

* Identify missing documentation

* Make sure team members follow the documented process

* Improve processes based on problems that occur during fulfillment



Our goal is to build a company that does not depend on information being stored only in one person’s head.



## What We Are Looking For



The right person for this role is:



* Highly organized

* Proactive

* Dependable

* Detail-oriented

* Comfortable following up with people

* Able to communicate professionally with clients

* Able to manage several projects at the same time

* Calm when priorities change

* Willing to take ownership of outcomes

* Able to think several steps ahead

* Comfortable asking questions when something is unclear

* Able to make decisions without needing constant approval

* Interested in improving systems and processes

* Consistent with communication

* Able to identify potential delays before deadlines are missed



You should naturally notice when something has not been completed and take action without waiting to be reminded.

* Wait for someone to tell you every next step

* Avoid difficult conversations or follow-ups

* Regularly forget details

* Are uncomfortable holding others accountable

* Only update ClickUp when someone reminds you

* Become overwhelmed when managing several projects

* Disappear during your working hours

* Allow unanswered questions to sit unresolved

* Strong organizational and time-management skills

* Experience communicating with clients through
 and meetings

* Reliable computer and internet connection

* Ability to work independently

* Ability to manage multiple deadlines and projects

* Ability to document and improve processes

* Willingness to learn website development and SEO fulfillment processes



Experience working for a web design, marketing, SEO, or digital agency is strongly preferred.



## Working Hours and Availability



This is a full-time position requiring 40 hours per week, Monday through Friday.



You must be available for a daily meeting with Christopher at:



**8:00 a.m. Central Time, Monday through Friday**



Because this is a communication-heavy role, you must also be responsive and available during your agreed working hours. Your working schedule will be established so that you have enough overlap with Christopher, the team, and our clients.



This is not a position where you can complete all your work without communicating with the team. Active communication throughout the workweek is an essential part of the job.

title: Technical Layout Designer - Marketing
description:
Technical Layout Designer (Catalogues, Datasheets & Manuals | PDF Rebuild ? Ongoing Maintenance | Remote, Part-Time)



We are looking for a detail-focused Technical Layout Designer to create product catalogues/brochures, and to recreate existing product catalogues, datasheets, and manuals from PDF and Word files into fully editable templates. The role also includes ongoing updates and maintenance.



You will be using Adobe InDesign, Illustrator, CorelDRAW, Canva, Affinity Publisher, or similar layout/design software. (Software is flexible — see below.)



This is a long-term, part-time remote role with a heavier workload during the initial rebuild phase, followed by 1–2 hours per week of ongoing maintenance work.



Role Overview



You will be responsible for rebuilding existing technical documents from PDF format into structured, editable templates.



This includes:



Product catalogues

Technical datasheets

Instruction manuals



The initial phase will involve recreating existing documents from PDF/Word files into editable templates, while simultaneously using these templates to produce targeted, sales-focused brochures for specific applications (for example, a spray booth product catalogue).



This means you will be building the underlying template system as part of real, practical brochure and catalogue production, ensuring the structure works for actual sales materials from the outset.



Once this foundation is established, the role transitions into ongoing maintenance work of approximately 1–2 hours per week, consisting of updates, revisions, and small additions as required.



This role is ideal for someone experienced in structured, detail-heavy documentation work where accuracy and consistency are critical.



Key Responsibilities



Initial phase (higher workload):

Recreate catalogues, datasheets, and manuals from PDF/Word files into editable templates

Build consistent, reusable layout systems across all document types

Ensure high accuracy in layout reproduction (spacing, typography, alignment, structure)

Convert technical product data into clean, structured formats

Standardise formatting across multiple document types



Ongoing phase (1–2 hours per week):

Update catalogues, datasheets, and manuals as product information changes

Add new products or technical updates into existing templates

Maintain consistency across all documentation versions

Produce print-ready and digital PDF outputs



Requirements

Experience recreating or rebuilding structured documents from PDF or print

Strong attention to detail (especially technical, numerical, and formatting accuracy)

Ability to follow and replicate existing layouts precisely

Strong understanding of layout systems, grids, and document structure

Comfortable working with structured data (e.g. Excel or similar)

Ability to work independently and maintain consistency across multiple document types



Software

Software is flexible — we are not concerned with specific tools, as long as you can deliver accurate, professional, print and
-ready documentation.



Common tools for this type of work include:

Adobe InDesign, Illustrator, CorelDRAW, Canva, Affinity Publisher, or similar layout/design software.



Nice to Have

Experience with technical, industrial, engineering, or manufacturing documentation

Experience in production design, pre-press, or technical publishing

Familiarity with datasheets or instruction/manual formatting standards

Ability to improve structure, consistency, and workflow efficiency

Experience working with large multi-page document sets



Work Arrangement

Part-time, flexible hours

Higher workload during initial rebuild phase

Then 1–2 hours per week ongoing maintenance

Long-term role for the right person



Please include your expected hourly rate (USD) in your application.



We are open to negotiation depending on experience and quality of work.



Important Note



This role is primarily focused on accurate reconstruction of existing technical documents from PDF, including supplier brochures being converted into company-branded catalogues. The priority is precision, consistency, and reliable template building across catalogues, datasheets, and manuals.



In some cases, you will also be required to create targeted, industry-specific catalogues from existing materials. For example, developing a spray booth catalogue by adapting an existing catalogue template and selecting relevant products for that application. This involves structuring and presenting existing product data in a clear, sales-focused format while maintaining consistency with our branding and documentation standards.



To Apply Please Include

Examples of catalogue, datasheet, or manual layout work (especially PDF reconstruction work)

Your expected hourly rate (USD)

Brief description of your experience with structured technical documentation

Availability during the initial higher-workload phase (hours per week)



Please include the word TECHNICAL REBUILD in your application so we know you have read the full description.

title: Amazon Product Development and Sourcing Specialist | China Negotiation | 3+ Years PL Experience
description:
Who We Are

BTS Brands is an 8-year-old private label company selling across US, CA, UK, EU, AU, JP and expanding into Saudi Arabia. We operate across two brands - one in the travel accessories category and one in beauty devices - with 52+ active SKUs.



We're not a startup figuring things out - we have systems, a team, and a clear direction. What we need now is someone senior who can take full ownership of product development for one of our brands while we scale.



The Role

This is not a VA role. This is a specialist position for someone who has done this before and can work independently.

You will own the full product lifecycle for one brand: from identifying opportunities, to negotiating with Chinese suppliers on WeChat, to making sure samples, timelines, packaging, and user manuals are all on track before launch. You'll also do product research for our second brand.

You'll work closely with our marketing and design team, and report directly to the owner.



What You'll Do Daily:

- Conduct product research across Amazon marketplaces (US/CA/UK/EU/AU/JP)

- Analyze competition, demand, pricing, and profitability (ROI, FBA fees, net margin)

- Communicate directly with Chinese suppliers via WeChat - negotiate pricing, MOQs, timelines

- Request and evaluate samples, coordinate quality checks

- Monitor production timelines and flag delays before they become problems

- Review packaging and user manuals for compliance (not copy, just accuracy)

- Calculate profitability at every stage before committing to a launch

- Collaborate with marketing and graphic design teams on launch prep

- Report weekly with recommendations and progress updates



Tools You Must Know:

- Helium 10 (Cerebro, Black Box, Xray, Keyword Tracker)

- Keepa - price history, trends, seasonality

- Amazon Seller Central - BSR, sales data interpretation

- Alibaba + WeChat - supplier sourcing and negotiation

- Google Sheets / Excel - ROI models, dashboards, profitability trackers

- Jungle Scout - a plus



Who We're Looking For:

- 3–5 years experience in Amazon Private Label product development and sourcing

- You've negotiated directly with Chinese suppliers - not just browsed Alibaba

- You think in numbers: margins, costs, lead times, risks

- You communicate clearly in English, written and verbal

- You're organized and proactive - you chase timelines, you don't wait to be chased

- You want a long-term role with room to grow, not a short contract



Compensation & Setup:

- $1,000–$1,400/month based on experience

- Full-time, 40h/week

- 14 days paid leave after 3 months

- First 3 months: time-tracked via Time Doctor (removed after we establish trust)

- Long-term position - We Invest in People Who Invest in Us



Important

This role is for one of our brands that currently has no team. You'll be building from the ground up with clear direction from ownership. If you need someone to micromanage your daily tasks, this isn't the right fit. If you thrive with clear objectives and autonomy, keep reading.





To Apply - Required

Answer these 4 questions. Applications without answers will not be considered:



1. Describe a product you sourced from a Chinese supplier, how did you find them, how did you negotiate, and what was the final outcome? Include the platform you used to find them (Alibaba, WeChat, trade show etc.), the MOQ you negotiated, and one specific thing that almost went wrong. title: Job Title: B2B Pitch Deck Copywriter / Presentation Designer
description:
I’m looking for a long-term B2B Pitch Deck Copywriter / Presentation Designer to help create clear, persuasive pitch decks and proposals for a creative AI video and marketing business.



This role is for someone who understands how to turn a service offer into a client-facing presentation that makes the value obvious.



The main skill I’m looking for is B2B pitch deck creation.



You should be able to take rough notes, strategy, service descriptions, client problems, examples, pricing, and case-study material, then turn them into a clean, structured pitch deck that helps a potential client understand:



What problem we solve

Why it matters to them

How our service helps

What the process looks like

What they get

Why it is valuable

What the next step is



You do not need to create the company strategy, offer, positioning, or final sales argument from scratch. I will provide the commercial direction, offer strategy, client context, and final judgment.



Your job is to help turn that direction into a clear, well-written, well-designed pitch deck that sells the service in a way the client can understand quickly.



The work may include:



Creating B2B pitch decks from rough notes and strategy calls

Improving proposal structure and flow

Writing clear slide headlines

Turning service features into client benefits

Making complex ideas simple

Organizing decks around problem, solution, process, proof, offer, and next steps

Cleaning up existing decks and proposals

Improving visual hierarchy and layout

Creating simple diagrams, frameworks, and comparison slides

Formatting client-facing documents

Preparing pitch decks in Google Slides, PowerPoint, Canva, or Keynote

Adapting decks for different client types or industries

Working with AI video, creative production, marketing, and storytelling service offers



Required:



Strong B2B pitch deck experience

Strong written English

Ability to write clear, benefit-led slide copy

Good understanding of how to sell services to business clients

Good presentation design sense

Ability to simplify complex services into a clear buying path

Ability to structure a deck logically from problem to solution to offer

Ability to work from rough notes and improve them

Good attention to detail

Reliable daily communication

Ability to take feedback and revise quickly



Nice to have:



Experience creating decks for agencies, consultants, creative studios, SaaS, marketing companies, production companies, or startups

Experience with Google Slides, PowerPoint, Canva, Keynote, or Figma

Experience writing proposals or sales documents

Experience with StoryBrand, direct response, sales messaging, or B2B copywriting

Experience with AI, video production, social media content, marketing, or creative services

Basic design ability for clean, professional business presentations

Ability to create simple charts, process diagrams, and offer breakdowns



Please apply with:



1. A short note about your B2B pitch deck or proposal experience

2. Links to pitch decks, proposals, or presentation samples you have created

3. A short explanation of how you turn a service into a client benefit

4. A short explanation of how you structure a sales deck

5. The tools you use for deck creation

6. Whether you prefer writing, design, or both

7. Whether you are looking for full-time or part-time work

8. Your expected monthly salary



To show that you read this job post carefully, put the word VH_DECK at the end of your subject line or application title.



I’m looking for someone who can help me turn strong strategic thinking into clear sales material. The right person will understand business clients, write clearly, design cleanly, and help make our services easier to buy.

title: US Company Hiring: Senior GEO + Branded-Search Specialist (Skincare, Shopify) - Long Term

   Gemini, Google AI Overviews).

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Content: briefs, drafting, and editing in clean English, built to get cited by

  AI and to own branded results. Health-adjacent beauty content, so accuracy matters.



YOU MUST HAVE



- Real, demonstrable GEO / AI-search experience: getting brands mentioned or

  cited in ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, or Google AI Overviews. This is central

  and we will test it, not just take your word for it.

- Experience controlling branded / reputation search results on Google (branded

- Familiarity with E-E-A-T and YMYL content standards.

,000/month full-time, with room above for the right person.

 which brands to name, and what are two

trial task covering both pillars: improving our branded Google results, and

getting us cited in AI.

title: Bookkeeper
description:
About Us

We are a small Australia-based accounting firm building a high-performing remote team in the Philippines. We value accuracy, reliability, and teamwork, and we're looking for a dedicated Bookkeeper who takes pride in producing quality work.



Role Summary

We are seeking an experienced and detail-oriented Bookkeeper to join our team as a full-time remote contractor.

The successful candidate will work 6 hours per day, Monday to Friday, supporting our Australian accounting team. This role is ideal for someone who has strong bookkeeping experience, enjoys working independently, and is committed to delivering accurate, high-quality work.



The role involves managing day-to-day bookkeeping functions, including accounts payable, accounts receivable, payroll, bank reconciliations, GST coding, journals, and financial reporting. Experience with Xero is essential, while familiarity with MYOB and QuickBooks is highly regarded.



Key Responsibilities

Process accounts payable and accounts receivable transactions accurately and on time.

Prepare and issue customer invoices.

Process supplier bills and maintain accurate payment records.

Perform regular bank reconciliations.

Process payroll using Xero Payroll and Employment Hero.

Assist with payroll administration, including leave, superannuation, and Single Touch Payroll (STP) requirements.

Prepare general journal entries as required.

Apply correct debit and credit principles in bookkeeping transactions.

Accurately code GST transactions and assist with BAS preparation.

Maintain complete, accurate, and up-to-date bookkeeping records.

Prepare financial reports for clients and internal review.

Assist the accounting team in preparing and consolidating reports for client requirements.

Communicate professionally with clients regarding bookkeeping queries and requests.

Support month-end and year-end bookkeeping processes.

Follow internal procedures and maintain consistent quality standards.



Required Skills & Experience

Minimum of 3 years' bookkeeping or accounting experience.

Strong understanding of accounts payable and accounts receivable processes.

Good knowledge of Australian GST requirements and bookkeeping practices.

Proven experience using Xero, including invoicing, payroll, accounts payable, and accounts receivable.

Experience with Employment Hero Payroll is highly desirable.

Experience with MYOB and/or QuickBooks is an advantage.

Sound understanding of general journals, debits, and credits.

Ability to process payroll accurately using Xero Payroll.

Intermediate or advanced Microsoft Excel skills.

Ability to prepare and interpret financial reports.

Strong organizational and time management skills.

Ability to work independently while managing multiple priorities.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.



Personal Attributes

Reliable, responsible, and accountable.

Proactive and solution-oriented.

Able to follow established procedures.

Eager to learn and continuously improve.

Collaborative team player with excellent communication skills.

Professional, organized, and dependable.



Work Schedule

Full-time contractor position.

30 hours per week, Monday to Friday.

Some overlap with Australian business hours may be required.





What We're Looking For

Accuracy, consistency, and attention to detail are essential in this role, as the quality of bookkeeping directly impacts client reporting, BAS preparation, payroll compliance, and business decision-making.



We're looking for someone who can confidently manage recurring bookkeeping tasks with minimal supervision while contributing positively to a collaborative remote team. If you take pride in producing accurate work and enjoy supporting clients and colleagues, we'd love to hear from you.

title: AI Developer — Agents, Automation & SaaS Tools
description:
Solomon X is an AI consulting and agent development company serving mid-market businesses in the UAE and South Africa. We build and deploy AI agents that absorb the repetitive, expensive work inside businesses — quoting, operations, customer care, growth, and orchestration — so the people inside those businesses can focus on what only humans can do.



We're looking for a skilled AI developer to join as our core builder. You'll work directly with the founder to design, build, and maintain the tools we sell to clients.



What you'll build:



- AI agents using the Claude API (agentic workflows, tool use, structured outputs, RAG pipelines)

- Automation workflows in n8n connecting APIs, webhooks, databases, and messaging channels (WhatsApp,
, SMS)

- Backend systems on Supabase (Postgres, auth, storage, edge functions)

- Frontend interfaces in Next.js for client dashboards and agent management

- Multi-tenant SaaS architecture — one engine, many clients, configuration-driven (not custom-coded per client)

- Prompt engineering and agent logic for verticals like panel beaters, electrical contractors, professional services



What we expect:



- You can take a brief and ship working code, not just ideas

- You build for reuse — every workflow and agent is a template, not a one-off

- You log everything by default — structured outputs, audit trails, traceable decisions

- You communicate clearly and flag blockers early

- You're comfortable with ambiguity in a fast-moving early-stage build



Tech stack (what you need to know):



- Claude API / Anthropic SDK — non-negotiable

- n8n (self-hosted workflow automation) — non-negotiable

- Supabase (Postgres, auth, storage) — non-negotiable

- Next.js / React — required

- REST APIs, webhooks, JSON — required

- Python or JavaScript/TypeScript — at least one fluently

- WhatsApp Business API (360dialog or Twilio) — a strong plus

- Vector databases / RAG architecture — a strong plus



This role is right for you if:

- You've built AI agents or automation workflows that real users actually use

- You enjoy the problem-solving side of building, not just executing tickets

- You want to grow with a business that's serious about quality, not just speed

- You're reliable, honest, and you do what you say you'll do



This role is not for you if:



- You need heavy hand-holding or detailed specs for everything

- You've only worked with no-code tools and haven't touched real APIs

- You treat every project as a brand new snowflake instead of looking for reusable patterns



Hours: Starting at 20 hours/week, scaling to full-time as the business grows. Flexible hours — results matter more than when you work.



To apply: Send a short note explaining one AI agent or automation workflow you've built, what problem it solved, and what tools you used. No note = no review.

title: Education and Training Administrator
description:
Position Overview

The Education and Training Administrator is responsible for providing comprehensive

administrative, operational, and coordination support to the Education and Training Manager

across the IntegrityX Group.

The primary purpose of this role is to increase the operational capacity of the Education and

Training Manager by assuming responsibility for routine administrative, operational, and

coordination activities that support the effective management of the Education and Training

Department.

The role supports the efficient operation of the Education and Training Department across

multiple business units by ensuring that administrative processes are completed accurately,

documentation is maintained, projects remain organised, and routine operational activities are

coordinated effectively.

Working closely with the Education and Training Manager, the Training Development Officer,

and the Education and Training Officers, the Education and Training Administrator provides

operational support across departmental initiatives while ensuring that administrative processes

are delivered efficiently and consistently.

An understanding of educational environments, training operations, and learning administration

is highly beneficial to ensure effective support across the Education and Training Department.

The Education and Training Administrator does not perform instructional design, educational

delivery, tutoring, Training Needs Analysis, or management functions, but provides the

administrative support necessary for the Education and Training Manager, Training

Development Officer, and Education and Training Officers to operate efficiently.



Key Responsibilities

1. Executive and Departmental Management Support

Provide day-to-day administrative support to the Education and Training Manager.

Coordinate departmental administrative activities across multiple business units.

Prepare reports, presentations, trackers, and supporting documentation required by the

Education and Training Manager.

Maintain departmental action registers, project trackers, and operational records.

Monitor deadlines, outstanding actions, and follow-up requirements.

Coordinate administrative tasks arising from management meetings and strategic

initiatives.

Maintain departmental templates, forms, registers, and operational documentation.

Assist with the coordination of departmental projects and initiatives.

Maintain confidentiality of all departmental information and records.



2. Meeting Administration and Executive Reporting

Prepare agendas, meeting documentation, and presentation material for meetings

hosted by the Education and Training Manager.

Update management presentation slide decks using information supplied by the

Education and Training Manager.

Produce executive summaries fro
eting transcripts.

Compile action lists and extract key directives assigned to the Education and Training

Manager.

Maintain meeting action registers and monitor outstanding actions.

Coordinate meeting schedules, invitations, and follow-up communication.

Assist with the preparation of monthly and weekly departmental reporting.

Maintain accurate records of decisions, actions, and meeting outcomes.



3. Training Administration and Learning Management

System (LMS) Support

Administer training activities within Tekmatix and other approved Learning Management

Systems.

Upload training materials, videos, lesson resources, assessments, and supporting

documentation as directed.

Maintain course structures and learning resources within the LMS.

Enrol learners into training programmes as instructed by the Education and Training

Manager.

Allocate appropriate training programmes to employees across the IntegrityX Group.

Maintain learner records and training completion data.

Coordinate certification administration and maintain certificate records.

Support training implementation through accurate administration and system

maintenance.

Maintain training development trackers and administrative records.



4. Employee Onboarding and Training Coordination

Coordinate onboarding administration for new employees.

Create learner profiles and training records within approved systems.

Allocate onboarding and role-specific training programmes.

Schedule welcome meetings between new employees and the Education and Training

Manager.

Send onboarding communications and training information on behalf of the Education

and Training Manager.

Monitor onboarding progress and training completion.

Maintain onboarding trackers and escalate outstanding actions where required.

Support onboarding administration across all IntegrityX Group business units.



5. Smart Workforce Academy Administration

Coordinate administrative activities relating to Academy learners.

Respond to routine learner enquiries using approved information and templates.

Monitor learner progress through administrative tracking.

Maintain learner records and certification registers.

Confirm completion of automated learner communication processes.

Support alumni administration and routine follow-up activities.

Escalate educational, commercial, or management enquiries to the Education and

Training Manager where appropriate.



6. Education Administration and Project Logistics

Provide administrative support for education-related projects as directed by the

Education and Training Manager.

Support preparation of management documentation for education meetings.

Update administrative sections of education project documentation under the direction of

the Education and Training Manager.

Coordinate logistical requirements for approved learner activities, educational

programmes, and departmental projects.

Research suppliers and obtain quotations for approved educational resources,

stationery, equipment, and learning materials.

Prepare procurement information for purchasing by the appropriate personnel.

Coordinate logistical requirements associated with approved educational events and

activities.

Maintain administrative records relating to departmental education projects.



7. Documentation, Records and Operational

Administration

Maintain organised electronic filing systems and document repositories.

Apply approved naming conventions and version control procedures.

Maintain departmental trackers, registers, calendars, and operational records.

Perform administrative quality checks on documentation and records.

Monitor document completeness and identify missing or outdated information.

Maintain departmental templates and standard documentation.

Ensure accurate record keeping across departmental systems.

Support audit readiness through organised documentation management.



8. Stakeholder Communication and Project Coordination

Coordinate routine communication between internal stakeholders, learners, and external

service providers.

Send reminders, follow-ups, confirmations, and administrative correspondence on behalf

of the Education and Training Manager.

Coordinate project administration across departmental initiatives.

Monitor project milestones and follow up on outstanding deliverables.

Maintain communication records and project documentation.

Escalate matters requiring managerial judgement to the Education and Training

Manager.



9. Personal Learning and Internal Compliance

Maintain knowledge of IntegrityX Group systems, policies, SOPs, and administrative

procedures.

Participate in departmental meetings and training activities.

Develop proficiency in approved digital platforms, Learning Management Systems, and

AI-supported administrative tools.

Maintain high standards of professionalism, confidentiality, and organisational

excellence.

Continuously identify opportunities to improve administrative efficiency within the

Education and Training Department.

Required Skills and Attributes



Qualifications

A recognised Certificate, Diploma or Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration,

Office Administration, Education, Training, Project Administration, or a related field is

preferred.

A qualification or recognised certification in Office Administration, Executive

Administration, Project Administration, Business Administration, or a related

administrative discipline will be advantageous.

A teaching qualification, tutoring experience, or an educational background will be

considered advantageous due to the nature of the department and the support provided

across education and training initiatives.



Experience

Previous experience in an administrative, executive support, project coordination,

training administration, or education administration role.

Experience working within a Learning Management System (preferably Tekmatix) or

similar online learning platforms will be advantageous.

Experience supporting multiple stakeholders and coordinating projects within a

fast-paced environment.

Experience working remotely within an international organisation will be advantageous.



Skills and Attributes

Excellent organisational and administrative skills.

Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.

Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy.

Strong time management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet

deadlines.

High level of proficiency in Google Workspace and Microsoft Office applications.

Experience using Learning Management Systems (preferably Tekmatix) is

advantageous.

Strong administrative coordination and project management skills.

Ability to work independently in a remote environment while supporting multiple

stakeholders.

Strong problem-solving and organisational skills.

Professional, proactive, and service-oriented approach.

Ability to maintain confidentiality and exercise sound administrative judgement.

Willingness to learn and utilise AI-supported administrative tools and emerging

technologies to improve operational efficiency.

Ability to support an executive-level manager through effective planning, organisation,

coordination, and follow-up.

title: Senior Video Editor
description:
*** Please read the entire post before applying. Thanks! ***



*** About the Role ***



If you want editing work that actually matters, this is it!



Engage Video Production (EVP) creates educational and communication-focused video for aerospace, defense, and other technical clients. You will help turn complex subjects into something clear and usable, whether that means explaining how satellites stay in orbit, helping engineers communicate their work, or building training content people can actually follow. The work is structured and built for real-world use, not just visuals.



This is a full-time, 40-hour-per-week role working directly with the Creative Director. Projects range from short explainers to long-form training content. Aerospace and defense are our core specialties, but our projects vary widely, so we need an editor who is adaptable, technically proficient, and comfortable shifting styles to fit each client's goals.



If you need reminders to respond or follow up, this is not a fit. If you spot issues early, communicate clearly, and take ownership of your work, keep reading.



*** The Three Pillars of Success at EVP ***



To succeed here, you need to live these three values:



Discipline: You follow through on every task without floundering or ghosting. You manage your time and meet deadlines without constant supervision.



Ownership / Initiative: You do more than complete tasks. You look for ways to improve the work and support the team.



Integrity / Accountability: You own your mistakes right away. You have the backbone to point out errors for correction, even your own, because precision here is non-negotiable.



*** Role Overview ***



You will execute the editing of active projects under the guidance of our Creative Director. Aside from syncs and updates to align on priorities, you work independently. You are responsible for your output, your timeline, and how you communicate progress.



The ideal candidate works independently on assigned tasks, manages large volumes of data, and communicates proactively. You take pride in technical accuracy and understand how a project's storytelling drives results for the client.



*** Core Responsibilities ***



Video Editing: Edit short- and long-form content from start to finish, with strong storytelling and pacing on every project.



Media Management: Organize, sync, and manage large volumes of footage. You must be comfortable with projects ranging from hundreds of gigabytes to multiple terabytes.



Technical Finishing: Perform professional color correction and grading on all deliverables, including RAW workflows, and keep visual consistency.



Audio and Sound Design: Integrate music, handle basic audio cleanup and mixing, and make sure sound design fits the project's goals.



Graphics: Apply motion graphics, titles, and lower thirds as the project requires, for a polished, professional product.



Feedback and Coordination: Implement revisions efficiently and meet agreed deadlines. You will coordinate daily with the Creative Director and, when applicable, other editors or freelancers.



Team Growth and Standards: Help grow our junior editors and improve how we work. You will share what you know, give clear feedback on their edits, and streamline our editing practices, templates, and workflows so the whole team moves faster and more consistently.



Communication: This is part of the job, not an extra. Send progress updates as needed, flag blockers early and suggest solutions, and stay aligned with the Creative Director and company priorities. Silent work does not fly here.



*** Required Qualifications ***



Professional Background: Real experience in video editing (freelance or agency), with a solid grasp of pacing, storytelling, and professional delivery formats.



Software: High proficiency in DaVinci Resolve or Adobe Premiere Pro. Resolve is our preferred NLE, but we welcome expert Premiere editors who deliver professional results.



Technical Foundations: Strong audio cleanup and mixing, plus color correction and grading workflows.



RAW Workflow (Required): Proven, hands-on experience editing and grading RED RAW footage. This is a senior role, so we expect you to own complex, high-resolution RAW workflows from day one.



Leadership and Process: You can mentor less-experienced editors, give clear and useful feedback, and tighten how the team works. You make the people and the process around you better, not just your own edits.



Data and Infrastructure: A reliable, high-speed internet connection is non-negotiable. You will regularly receive hundreds of gigabytes to terabytes of footage and must be comfortable managing that volume.



Autonomy and Communication: Excellent written English and a proactive approach to reporting. You work without micromanagement and stay vocal about timelines, challenges, and progress.



*** Bonus / Preferred Skills ***



- Motion graphics (Fusion, After Effects, or similar)

- Graphic design for diagrams or visual explainers

- Experience with technical, educational, or corporate content

- Familiarity with 
 or structured feedback workflows

- Interest in aerospace, defense, or technical subjects



*** Compensation ***



Hourly Rate: $8.00 to $15.00 USD per hour. Your starting rate depends on experience and demonstrated skill.

This is a full-time role and full-time is what we are after. That said, if you are clearly qualified but can only commit part-time right now, apply anyway and tell us your availability.



Full-Time (40 hrs/week): $1,280 to $2,400 USD per month (about 78,000 to 146,000 PHP).

Part-Time (20 hrs/week): $640 to $1,200 USD per month (about 39,000 to 73,000 PHP).

[*Conversions are approximate.]



*** A Note on AI and Judgment ***



At EVP, we use advanced tools every day. But this role requires real human judgment and radical integrity. We are hiring a human, not a prompt.



If you use AI to draft your personal responses in the "How to Apply" section, you fail the first test of this role: honesty. We want your real thoughts and your real personality so we can tell whether you fit our team. If your application has no genuine human voice, it will be discarded. Use AI to assist your workflow later. Do not use it to represent your character now.



*** How to Apply ***



Follow these steps exactly. Attention to detail is part of the job.



- Set your subject line to: "Passionate Video Editor - [Your Name]"

- Use a minimum of 7 apply points (AP).

- Provide a link to your best and most current editing work. Include anything you want to highlight, such as motion-graphics-heavy editing. No portfolio means no consideration.

- State the 10th word of our "Three Pillars" section.

- In exactly two sentences, describe your experience with RED RAW footage. If you have none, explain how you plan to handle the learning curve and hardware demands of high-resolution RAW media. Plain English only. No AI-generated fluff.

- Attach or link to your CV/resume in PDF format only.

- We expect senior applicants to record a 60-second video (Loom or similar) introducing yourself. It is not a hard requirement, but at this level skipping it is a missed opportunity. Tell me why you are the right pick and what interests you about aerospace and defense. Start the video by addressing me by name (Ryan). Applicants who include it move to the top of the list.



Thanks for your time and genuine interest.
