title: Growth and Marketing Technology Specialist
description:
"Opportunities don't happen. You create them." – Chris Grosser



------



About Barnes Nest (US)



Barnes Nest is a U.S.-based online marketplace for home services.



Our mission is simple: make hiring a trusted local contractor easy, safe, and fair — for both sides.



Homeowners post a project, compare quotes from verified local pros, and pay securely through escrow, so money is only released when the work is approved. Contractors and handymen get real local jobs with no lead fees — they only pay a small percentage on jobs they actually complete.



We're launching in our first U.S. metro, and we need someone who can help us grow it smarter, not just harder.



------



About the Role



This isn't a traditional marketing role.



We're looking for someone who enjoys figuring things out.



Someone who sees a manual, repetitive task and immediately starts looking for a way to automate it.



You'll work directly with the founder to grow both sides of the marketplace — using AI, no-code automation, and smart marketing to bring contractors and homeowners onto the platform and keep them active.



No two weeks look the same.



One week you may be building an automated outreach sequence with a no-code tool.



The next you could be setting up an AI workflow to qualify leads, designing a content engine for social, building a simple dashboard, or testing a new channel to find users faster.



If you enjoy learning and love making things run on their own, this role will never become repetitive.



------



What You'll Be Doing



- Drive growth on both sides of the marketplace — contractors and homeowners

- Build and automate outreach and marketing workflows using no-code tools

- Use AI to speed up research, lead qualification, content, and follow-up

- Set up and manage CRM and marketing automation (sequences, triggers, tracking)

- Grow and run our social channels with a repeatable content system

- Find, test, and scale new channels to acquire users

- Build simple reports and dashboards to track what's working

- Document the systems you build so they can scale to new cities

- Research new AI and automation tools and recommend what to adopt



------



What We're Looking For



We're far more interested in attitude and ability than a perfect résumé. Fresh graduates are welcome to apply



The ideal person is:



- Naturally curious

- Loves solving problems and removing manual work

- Highly organised

- Comfortable learning new software fast

- Not afraid of technology or AI

- Works independently with minimal supervision

- Takes ownership instead of waiting for instructions

- Goal-driven and focused on outcomes

- Analytical and enjoys working with data

- Always looking for a faster, smarter way to do things

- From Manila preferred and be able to cowork in person once a week



------



Technical Skills



Experience in some (not necessarily all) of the following is highly desirable:



- AI platforms including ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini

- No-code automation tools (Zapier, Make, n8n or similar)

- Marketing platforms and
/outreach tools

- CRM platforms and pipeline management

- Social media management and content tools (Canva, schedulers)

- Reporting, analytics, and dashboards

- List-building / prospecting tools (Apollo, Hunter or similar)



Bonus points if you've:



- Built AI workflows or agents

- Connected AI tools with no-code automations

- Created an automated lead-gen or content engine

- Used AI to improve processes rather than just generate content

- Worked with U.S. clients, home services, or marketplace/startup growth



------



Who Will Thrive Here



You'll love this role if you enjoy:



- Learning something new every week

- Automating away repetitive work

- Building systems that scale

- Finding efficiencies and better channels

- Working with AI and no-code tools

- Turning ideas into working processes

- Watching numbers grow because of something you built



------



What We Offer



- Full-time remote position — day shift, 8:00 AM start

- Direct mentoring from the members

- A real chance to grow with us as we scale to more cities



------



How to Apply



Send your application along with the following:



- Start your message with the word "NEST" so we know you read this post.

- Briefly tell us about your growth, marketing, or automation experience — including any results.

- Which AI tools do you currently use, and how have you used them beyond writing content?

Applications without the word "NEST" will not be considered.

title: AI-Native Digital Growth Specialist
description:
Role purpose

We are looking for an AI-native digital growth specialist to help us grow organic search visibility, AI visibility, Google advertising performance and online marketing ROI.



We are a trade-only B2B ecommerce supplier in Australia. We currently sell through a WooCommerce website and are moving to Shopify Plus in the medium term.



This role will help manage and improve our search, content, advertising and reporting systems so our online marketing becomes more effective, more measurable and less dependent on external agencies.



This is not just a traditional SEO role. We want someone who understands SEO, AEO, AI search visibility, Google Ads, content, analytics, ecommerce conversion and how to use AI properly to work faster and smarter.



Core responsibilities



1. SEO and organic growth



• Improve rankings for commercial B2B search terms, especially keywords moving into stronger ranking positions

• Improve category pages, product pages, content pages, FAQs, internal links, metadata and headings

• Use Google Search Console, GA4 and SEO tools to identify opportunities and track results

• Support technical SEO work including redirects, canonicals, schema, indexation, crawl issues and ranking-sensitive page structure

• Support the WooCommerce to Shopify Plus migration from an SEO preservation and growth perspective



2. AEO, AI visibility and AI-native workflows



• Improve visibility in AI-generated answers and AI-assisted search journeys

• Track visibility across tools and environments such as Google AI Overviews, Gemini, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Copilot and Bing where practical

• Use AI tools properly for keyword clustering, competitor research, content briefs, ad copy testing, reporting, content improvement and workflow automation

• Create repeatable AI-assisted processes without compromising quality, accuracy or brand trust

• Keep moving with how buyers are using AI to research products and suppliers



3. Google Ads and performance marketing



• Be fully conversant with Google advertising products, including Search Ads, Shopping, Performance Max, YouTube, Demand Gen, Display, remarketing, Merchant Centre, GA4 and Google Tag Manager

• Help improve paid search and paid marketing ROI

• Review campaign structure, search terms, landing pages, conversion tracking and performance reporting

4. Content, authority and outreach

• Build content plans around real trade buyer needs, not generic blog activity

• Improve domain authority / reputation consistently

• Improve existing pages and create content briefs for new pages, guides, FAQs and support content

• Help build authority through relevant supplier, manufacturer, trade, partner, industry and content opportunities

• Focus on quality backlinks, genuine mentions and commercially useful authority wins rather than low-value link volume

• Track backlinks, referring domains, target pages, anchor text, quality, relevance and live status



5. Reporting and commercial accountability

• Build and maintain clear reporting across SEO, AEO, Google Ads and online marketing performance

• Report on organic traffic, keyword movement, ranking improvements, organic orders, new account signups, enquiries and revenue where available

• Report on AI visibility and brand mentions in AI/search environments

• Track marketing activity against commercial outcomes, not just activity completed

• Identify what is working, what is not working, and what should change



Key performance expectations



The role will be measured against agreed internal baselines and commercial outcomes, including:

• Improving our overall domain authority, domain rating and search authority over time

• Increasing organic traffic from priority commercial search terms

• Increasing the number of priority keywords ranking in stronger positions

• Improving measurable AI visibility month by month

• Improving ROI from Google Ads and other digital marketing channels used

• Creating clear monthly reporting that links activity to sales, enquiries, new accounts, traffic, rankings and commercial impact

• Maintaining safe, sustainable and quality-focused SEO practices



Required skills and experience



• Strong practical SEO experience, preferably in ecommerce or B2B ecommerce

• Experience improving category pages, product pages and commercial landing pages

• Strong Google Search Console, GA4 and keyword tracking experience

• Strong working knowledge of Google Ads, including Search, Shopping, Performance Max and remarketing

• Strong understanding of content-led SEO and authority building

• Practical understanding of AI search, AEO and how AI tools are changing search behaviour

• Confident using AI tools in day-to-day work to improve speed, quality and output

• Able to build reports that management can understand and act on

• Able to work remotely with clear priorities, accountability and regular updates

• Able to challenge weak assumptions and give practical recommendations, not just agree with everything



Nice-to-haves



• Shopify Plus SEO experience

• WooCommerce SEO experience

• Experience with B2B, trade, industrial, ecommerce or wholesale businesses

• Experience with Semrush, Ahrefs, SE Ranking, Screaming Frog, Looker Studio or similar tools

• Experience with Google Merchant Centre and product feed optimisation

• Experience with Microsoft/Bing Webmaster Tools and AI visibility tracking

• Basic HTML/CSS understanding

• Experience working with developers on technical SEO tasks

• Experience creating content briefs for writers, designers or internal tea
mbers



Tools and workflow



• Work managed through a simple task board such as Basecamp or similar

• Weekly priorities agreed with management

• Clear monthly reporting required

• Standard process for SEO tasks, content briefs, ad reviews, technical requests and reporting

• All key tools, accounts and data must remain under company ownership and access



Employment model



• Part-time or full time role

• Long-term role for the right person

We are not looking for someone who only produces generic SEO activity.



We want someone who can help us build a stronger internal digital growth system across SEO, AI visibility, Google Ads, content, reporting and ecommerce conversion.



The right person will be commercially minded, practical, direct, organised and outcome-focused.



Checklist for your application



Please include the following in your application:



1. Your experience with ecommerce SEO, especially category pages and product pages

2. Your experience with Google Ads, including which Google Ads products you have managed

3. Your experience with AI tools and how you use them in real marketing workflows

4. Your understanding of AEO / AI visibility and how you would track it

5. Your experience with Shopify, Shopify Plus or WooCommerce SEO

6. The SEO tools and reporting tools you have used

7. Examples of ranking, traffic, revenue, lead or ROI improvements you have helped achieve

8. One example of how you would improve a B2B ecommerce category page

9. One example of how you would assess backlink or authority quality

10. A short explanation of how you would approach the first 90 days in this role



Please do not apply if your SEO approach is mainly based on low-quality backlinks, generic blog posting, directory submissions or activity reports that do not connect to commercial outcomes.

title: Technical Onboarding Manager (Customer Success & Tech Support) - $900 Base + Performance Bonuses
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



We are hiring a Technical Onboarding Manager (TOM).



Your job is to guide new clients through their first 48 hours inside the program. You remove confusion, fix tech issues, assign the right 1:1 Coach, and make sure clients are fully set up before strategy begins.



This is not a passive support role. You are responsible for structure, clarity, activation speed, and client confidence.



This is a client-facing role. You must be clear, confident, calm, and reliable.



Most of our clients are 45+ and not tech-savvy. Patience and strong communication are required.



BENEFITS



- $900/month guaranteed base

- Performance bonuses based on CSAT (client rating) and CSQ (coach rating)

- OTE: $1,050–$1,400/month

- Bonus tiers from $30–$100 per category (minimum 20 surveys / 20 handoffs per month)

- Fully remote, long-term role

- Clear scorecard and monthly reviews

- Career growth path (Senior TOM, Lead TOM, CSM)

- 4,000+ clients served since 2019



SCHEDULE



- 7.5 hours per day (Monday to Friday)

- No fixed shift required. You may work a straight or split shift.

- You must attend tea
etings (usually 3pm CET)

- Work 7.5 total hours per day within the 8 AM ET to 2 AM ET coverage window, not across the entire window

- Confirm your preferred working hours during hiring

- Maintain a schedule that is sustainable long term



Consistently low energy or repeated mistakes caused by poor schedule management will be treated as performance issues.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run structured Activation Calls

- Fully activate every client within 48 hours. Activation means the client has access to Kajabi, Slack, the Client Master Sheet, AI tools (AVA & VERA), understands where everything is, has a Coach assigned, and has their Kickoff Call booked.

- Book Kickoff Call same day or next day

- Assign the correct 1:1 Coach based on phase, fluency, timezone, and availability

- Build authority for the assigned Coach so the client feels confident before strategy begins

- Ensure basic access or setup issues do not reach Coaches

- Update CRM immediately after each call

- Send clear handoff notes to Coaches

- Upload all call recordings

- Reply in #tech-support within 24 hours (weekdays)

- Onboard 20–25 clients per week. Activation Calls are structured and typically 30–45 minutes.

Some weeks are high-volume during promotions. Quality and clarity must remain strong under pressure.

- Keep your calendar accurate and available

- Proactively manage your calendar capacity and flag issues early

- Avoid repeated client-facing process errors



Main goal: Zero confusion for the client. No surprises for the Coach.



CORE STANDARDS



- 100% activation within 48 hours

- CSAT average 85%+

- No Kickoff Call no-shows

- Prevent basic technical escalations

- High CRM accuracy and immediate handoffs

- 24-hour Slack response time

- Reliable, consistent performance



REQUIREMENTS



- Strong customer support or onboarding experience

- C1 English or higher

- Calm with older or low-tech clients

- Comfortable repeating instructions clearly multiple times

- Follows SOPs and scripts closely

- Advanced Slack skills

- Comfortable with Kajabi, Google Drive, and Zoom

- Willing to learn basic creator tools

- Reliable internet, strong camera, proper lighting, and quiet workspace

- Strong schedule discipline



WE ARE NOT A FIT IF



- You are low energy or unclear

- You get frustrated with confused clients

- You cannot explain tech in simple words

- You struggle to follow structured processes

- You cannot consistently maintain agreed working hours

- You have poor camera, lighting, or internet setup



HOW TO APPLY



Fill in the form: 
/to/nI8lIXV4



In the Name field write: “TOM” + Your First and Last Name



Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.



P.S. Once hired, you will be contracted under Social Influence Consulting LLC.

title: Stock Management Admin (Big Seller)
description:
Join our team and become part of a dynamic, global organization of 40 professionals across Korea, Singapore, Malaysia, and the Philippines. Collaborate closely with our regional teams to grow an exciting portfolio of leading Korean brands, including Beauty of Joseon, Needly, Tirtir, and other top-trending names in the market.



We are specifically seeking a hands-on BigSeller ERP Expert. If you do not have direct, deep experience managing inventory, purchases, and syncing within BigSeller, please do not apply.



Key Responsibilities:



- Take ownership of the BigSeller account. Ensure "Available Stock" is perfectly synced across all stores to eliminate the risk of overselling during high-traffic mega-campaigns (11.11, 12.12).

- Manage the Inbound/Outbound process within BigSeller, including Stock-In (purchases), Stock-Out (promos/damage), and Warehouse Transfers.

- Lead weekly or monthly cycle counts and reconcile physical warehouse counts with BigSeller’s "On-Hand" data and resolve discrepancies between "On Hand," "Available," and "Reserved" stock.

- Inspect returned items, update stock status and process replacements.

- Monitors stock sync between Bigseller and URStore.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams and provide ad-hoc support.



Qualifications:



- 2–3 years of DIRECT, hands-on experience using BigSeller ERP (specifically the Stock Management, Reporting, and Purchase modules) is highly preferred.

- Proficient in Google sheets and Excel. Managing large datasets, utilizing advanced formulas (e.g., VLOOKUP, Pivot Tables), and generating performance reports.

- Strong numeracy for calculating weighted average costs and reconciling bulk shipments.

- Highly organized, able to prioritize tasks and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

title: Amazon Catalogue & Seller Central Specialist
description:
SALARY

Negotiable, based on experience. Full-time independent contractor, paid twice-monthly (15th & 30th). Additional December payment (paid pro rata to months worked in the first year). Please state your expected monthly rate in USD when you apply - see “How to Apply” below. We can agree the salary in PHP if preferred for stability and we will absorb all transfer fees. 



JOB OVERVIEW

We are a fast-growing UK toys and games company looking for an experienced, highly-organised Amazon Catalogue & Seller Central/Brand Registry Specialist to join our team full time. You’ll own the day-to-day health of our Amazon catalogue in the UK/Ireland across a growing portfolio of brands — building and fixing listings, managing flat files, handling A+ Content and Brand Stores, and driving Seller Central and Brand Registry cases through to resolution.



This is a hands-on, problem-solving role for someone who knows Amazon inside out and takes genuine ownership of their work. You will report directly to the primary Amazon account manager and work closely with a small, supportive team. As our reputation grows, more and more brands are joining us and our catalogue, and your scope, will keep expanding.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Catalogue & Listing Management

• Expert handling of Amazon flat files — bulk uploads, category/listing templates, partial updates, etc

• Creating new listings and editing/optimising existing ones (titles, bullets, descriptions, backend keywords, images, video, etc)

• Building and maintaining A+ Content, A+ Premium, and Brand Story modules

• Variation management — building, splitting, merging and fixing variation families

• Image/infographic management and ensuring listings meet Amazon image requirements in multiple marketplaces

• Pulling and working from Category Listings Reports to audit and bulk-update the catalogue

• Identifying and resolving listing errors, suppressed and stranded listings



Seller Central Case Management

• Opening, managing, escalating and following up Amazon cases until they’re fully resolved

• Resolving compliance and TIC (Trademark / IP / Compliance) issues, error codes and listing flags

• Managing policy violations and account health notifications

• Communicating clearly and persistently with Seller Support to push cases to final approval

• Keeping multiple open cases organised and chased so that nothing falls through the cracks



Content, Keyword & Competitor Research

• Competitor and keyword research using Helium 10 and AI tools

• Writing clear, well-optimised, native-quality English listing content

• Supporting optimisation updates and keyword coverage across the catalogue



Data Analysis & Reporting

• Analysing CTR, CVR, SQP, BSR, keyword rankings and other performance data

• Preparing clear, accurate weekly and monthly reports

• Spotting issues and opportunities in the data and flagging them proactively

• Monitoring stock levels, aged inventory, outlet deals, etc



ABOUT YOU

This role is for an experienced Amazon operator who is meticulous, proactive and genuinely enjoys solving catalogue and compliance problems.

• Strong, proven experience in Amazon catalogue management and Seller Central/Brand Registry

• Highly skilled with flat files and template uploads

• Confident in Seller Central case management — compliance/TIC, errors, escalations and policy violations

• Excellent in Excel

• Strong written English and grammar, and confident dealing directly with Amazon

• Comfortable with competitor/keyword research and writing listing content 

• Able to read and act on data

• Very organised — able to keep on top of many cases at once, following up and escalating regularly

• Self-sufficient and proactive — able to work under your own initiative without close supervision

• A fast, reliable, stable internet connection



BONUS SKILLS (NICE TO HAVE, NOT ESSENTIAL)

• Amazon PPC / advertising experience

• Experience with Claude Cowork/Chat GPT

• Experience with Canva (or similar graphic design / image editing tools)

• Experience with deals, vouchers, Prime Day, etc



THE ROLE & WORKING HOURS

• Full-time, working from home

• You’ll work across multiple brands — a portfolio that’s growing all the time

• Your hours must overlap UK working hours for at least 2 hours per day to start with and dropping to one hour later on. You’ll need to be available before 10am-11am UK time (5pm to 6pm Philippines time)

• You’ll report directly to the primary Amazon account manager — around 30 minutes each day to start with, dropping back to 60-90 minutes per week once you’re settled in

• Long-term, stable role with a growing company



HOW TO APPLY

Start your reply with the exact words “I really want to help you” (word for word). Applications that don’t start this way won’t be considered. Then include all of the following:

1. Your Amazon experience — years, level, and the kind of tasks you’ve handled (the more detail and the more complex the task the better. Wow us with your big wins!

2. The number of different clients you’ve worked with, and their industries (e.g. supplements, toys and games, clothing, etc.)

3. Examples of complex catalogue problems you’ve solved

4. Confirmation you’re ready to start full time by the end of July and your working hours

5. Your expected monthly rate (USD)

6. Any additional skills you think are relevant



Please answer all six points — incomplete applications won’t be considered.



WHY WORK WITH US?

We are a fast-growing UK toys and games company. Our products retail in many well-known high street chains, as well as via Amazon UK and Ireland. We own some of our brands directly and have agreements to sell the products of others.

As our reputation grows, more and more brands are approaching us — including 8-figure household names. You will have the chance to be part of a growing team in an exciting company, and you will have the opportunity to grow with us.



We will be reviewing all applications on Friday 3rd July so if we don’t respond straight away please be patient. We will be creating at least one short list and reducing that to the final candidates asap.

title: Operations Coordinator
description:
Are you the person everyone relies on to keep things running?



Do you enjoy solving problems, making decisions, and bringing order to chaos? Do you naturally take ownership instead of waiting for someone else to tell you what to do?



If you enjoy organizing people, communicating clearly, and solving real-world operational challenges, we'd love to meet you.



Chickadee Cleans is a fast-growing vacation rental cleaning company based in Phoenix, Arizona. We partner with professional property managers and short-term rental owners to keep their homes guest-ready through exceptional cleaning, inspections, communication, and reliability.



We're looking for an Operations Coordinator who will become a key part of our leadership team. As the company grows, this role is designed to grow into our Operations Manager position.



---



ABOUT THE ROLE



Your mission is simple:



**Keep the day running smoothly and solve problems before they become emergencies.**



You'll coordinate with cleaners, inspectors, property managers, and guests throughout the day to ensure every property is completed on time and to our standards.



Every day is different. Some days everything goes according to plan. Other days you'll be balancing schedule changes, cleaner call-outs, client questions, and unexpected challenges—all while keeping everyone informed and moving forward.



If you enjoy making decisions, communicating with people, and finding solutions under pressure, you'll likely enjoy this role.



---



WHAT YOU'LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR:



DAILY OPERATIONS

* Coordinate daily cleaning schedules.

* Monitor job progress throughout the day.

* Resolve scheduling conflicts.

* Coordinate backup coverage when unexpected issues arise.

* Help ensure every property is completed on time.



COMMUNICATION & INBOX MANAGEMENT

* Manage the main company inbox, including responding to calls and texts in a timely, professional manner.

* Communicate with cleaners and runners throughout the day.

* Respond professionally to property managers and clients.

* Keep everyone informed when schedules change.

* Resolve issues before they become larger problems.

* Handle inbound sales inquiries, including holding initial conversations with prospective clients.



DECISION MAKING

* Make independent decisions using company guidelines.

* Prioritize multiple situations happening simultaneously.

* Identify solutions rather than waiting for instructions.

* Escalate major issues when appropriate.



CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT

* Maintain accurate notes and operational records.

* Help improve systems and processes.

* Identify recurring issues and recommend better ways of operating.

* During lighter operational periods, you’ll have standing project work to fill your time productively—this may include process documentation, marketing post scheduling, or other initiatives. We’re looking for someone flexible who takes initiative to help the company in whatever way is most useful during down time.





---



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



The ideal candidate is someone who:

* Naturally takes ownership.

* Communicates professionally in written and spoken English.

* Remains calm under pressure.

* Enjoys solving problems.

* Thinks critically before asking for help.

* Is highly organized.

* Pays close attention to detail.

* Learns new software quickly.

* Is dependable and responsive—actively engaged for the full scheduled shift, not just waiting for messages to come in.

* Wants to grow into a leadership role.



As a small attention-to-detail exercise, please include "Yellow Bird" in the subject line of your application.



---



PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS



Experience in one or more of the following is helpful, but not required:

* Operations

* Dispatch

* Logistics

* Property management

* Customer service

* Project coordination

* Sales or customer-facing communication



You should also have:

* Excellent written and spoken English.

* A reliable computer and high-speed internet connection.

* A quiet workspace.

* Experience using Google Workspace.

* Comfort learning and working within multiple software platforms.

* Willingness to use time-tracking software during work hours.



---



SCHEDULE

* Full-time

* Thursday through Monday

* Hours fall within Arizona business hours (approximate window 8:00 AM–6:00 PM Arizona time); exact daily start and end time will be finalized with the selected candidate.

* Weekends are our busiest days and are an important part of this position.

* Additional paid hours may occasionally be available during holidays, busy seasons, or periods of company growth.

* Time-tracking software (e.g., Hubstaff) is required during all scheduled work hours.



---



GROWTH OPPORTUNITY



This is not intended to remain an entry-level operations position.



As you learn our business and demonstrate strong judgment and leadership, you'll take on increasing responsibility with the goal of growing into our Operations Manager.



We're looking for someone who wants to build a long-term career with a growing company.



---



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



Within your first several months:



* Daily operations run smoothly with minimal supervision.

* Most operational issues are resolved before management becomes involved.

* Cleaners receive timely communication and support.

* Clients and prospects receive prompt, professional responses.

* Operational processes continue to improve over time.



---



APPLICATION QUESTIONS



Please include:

1. Your resume.

2. A brief introduction about yourself.

3. Describe a time you successfully managed multiple urgent situations at once. How did you prioritize them?

4. Tell us about a process you improved in a previous role.



OPERATIONS SCENARIO



Please answer the following question in as much detail as you feel is necessary.



Imagine it is **8:15 AM Arizona time**. You are the Operations Coordinator for Chickadee Cleans.



All scheduled cleanings are planned to begin at **10:00 AM**.



You receive the following information at the same time:

* One cleaner calls out sick.

* A second cleaner lets you know they will be approximately 45 minutes late.

* A property manager asks if one of their homes will be ready for the scheduled **4:00 PM** guest check-in.

* A guest requests an early check-in at **2:00 PM**.



Walk us through exactly how you would handle the next 30 minutes.



Please explain:



* Which issue you would address first and why.

* What messages or phone calls you would make.

* What information you would gather before making decisions.

* How you would communicate with the cleaners, the property manager, and the guest.

* Any assumptions you make and why.



You may not have all of the information you want immediately, so explain what assumptions you would make and how you would verify them.



There is no single "correct" answer. We're interested in understanding how you prioritize, communicate, and make decisions when multiple urgent situations happen at once.

title: Looking for CapuCut Veo3 AI Video Editors
description:

=============================

You do not need to be an expert yet.

=============================



If you have generated AI video clips before, understand basic editing, and are interested in learning how to produce high-quality AI health and wellness creator-style videos, you are welcome to apply.

The most important things are:



* You understand basic video editing in CapCut

* You have tried AI video generation tools before (specifically Veo3)

* You are interested in learning this specific style of health and wellness content

* You have good visual judgment

* You can follow instructions carefully

* You are willing to improve through feedback

========================



You will  create content similar to these accounts:




arles/reels/


/chentaomed/reels/


stagram.co
lanskia/


/dr.rafaelvega/reels/


/wellnessbyvance/reels/



========================





What You Will Do



You will take proven scripts and reference videos, then turn them into finished AI-generated short-form videos.



Your work will include:



- Creating strong AI start frames based on a character, setting, script, product, and reference files

- Writing strong prompts that generate realistic, engaging start frames

- Using reference images/files correctly inside Google Flow

- Creating your own visual ideas based on what the script is saying for each clip

- Turning each script line into a clear visual scene

- Generating AI video clips from approved start frames

- Making scenes look natural, realistic, and engaging

- Keeping the same character and setting consistent across clips

- Building recipe-style, health-tip, wellness, and product-related short-form videos

- Editing the clips together in CapCut

- Adding captions

- Cutting dead space and tightening pacing

- Matching the style, pacing, and visual quality of reference videos

- Uploading completed videos to Google Drive or our system



========================



This is not just a basic video editing job.

The most important skill is being able to read a script and understand what the clip should look like visually.



========================



You need to learn how to think like this:



- What should the viewer see in this 
nt?

- What start frame would make this clip interesting?

- What prompt will create that frame?

- What reference files should be used?

- How do I keep the character consistent?

- How do I make this feel like a real health/wellness creator video instead of random AI content?



========================



Prompting is a major part of this role.



You will learn to write prompts that create strong start frames based on:



- The script

- The reference video

- The character

- The setting

- The product

- The action happening in the clip

- The style of the account we are recreating



========================



Tools



- We will provide access to the Google account with Google Flow

- Possible reimbursement may be available for required tools such as CapCut or other approved software, depending on the role and your performance.



You may use tools like:



- Google Flow / Veo

- AI image generation tools

- CapCut

- ChatGPT / Claude / Gemini

- Google Drive



========================



It would be nice if you already have:



- Experience creating AI health and wellness creator-style videos

- Experience writing prompts for AI images or AI videos

- Experience creating start frames for AI video generation

- Experience using reference images/files to guide AI output

- Experience with CapCut

- Strong English understanding

- Good visual taste

- Strong attention to detail

- Reliable internet

- Reliable computer or laptop

- Ability to follow instructions exactly

- Availability for consistent daily work

- Ability to take feedback and improve fast

- Long-term availability



========================



Preferred



- Experience with Google Flow / Veo

- Experience creating AI avatar content

- Experience creating recipe-style or health-tip videos

- Experience creating product-related AI videos

- Experience making content for TikTok, Instagram Reels, or
 Reels

- Experience matching reference videos closely

- Experience turning scripts into visual shot ideas



========================



Training & Feedback



- We provide continuous training, feedback, examples, systems, and direction.

- You do not need to figure everything out alone.

- However, you must already have enough experience and good visual judgment to understand the style of content we are making.

- We are looking for someone who can learn to write good prompts, create strong start frames, improve based on feedback, and become better over time.



========================



Compensation



- This is a long-term contractor role.

- Starting pay depends on your skill level, availability, and experience.

- There is room to grow for people who are reliable, fast, and produce high-quality work.

- Performance bonuses are available for strong work, especially when videos perform well or go viral.

- Top performers may grow into higher-paid roles over time.



========================



Important: How To Apply



Do not message me directly first.

>>>

Reports to: Mike Johnston, Founder & CEO



About the Company

The Johnston Group is a US-based portfolio of healthcare education and workforce companies headquartered in Houston, Texas. Our flagship brand, the National Pharmacy Technician Association (NPTA), is the largest professional association for pharmacy technicians in the United States — serving 80,000+ members through continuing education, specialty certifications, and workforce development programs.



Across our five operating entities, we develop educational content, run live and virtual events, manage certification programs, and serve both individual pharmacy technicians and employer clients nationwide. Our team is fully remote and distributed, with a strong core team based in the Philippines.

We're growing — and we need the books to stay clean as we scale.



About the Role

We're looking for a detail-oriented, dependable bookkeeper to own the day-to-day books across our five US-based business entities. This is a part-time, fully remote position (~20 hours/week) for someone who is genuinely comfortable in QuickBooks Online and Stripe and can keep clean, accurate books with minimal supervision.



You'll be the person who knows where every dollar is — managing receivables and payables, resolving payment issues, running reports, and closing the books each month so leadership always has a clear, current picture across all entities.



What You'll Do

- Manage the books for five business entities in QuickBooks Online, keeping each entity clean, current, and properly separated
